Class Netty4HeadersAdapter

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.http.support.Netty4HeadersAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Map<String, List<String>>, MultiValueMap<String,String>
public final class Netty4HeadersAdapter extends Object implements MultiValueMap<String,String>
用于封装 Netty 4 HTTP 标头的 MultiValueMap 实现。
